issues.issue: Do the officer's reasons show that he assessed Mr. Abbasi's duties against the NOC 0631 lead statement and main duties?
issues.applicant_position: The one-sentence reasons show no evaluation of his McDonald's duties, so the refusal is unintelligible.
issues.respondent_position: Reasons can be supplemented from the record; the employer letter closely matches NOC 0631 duties.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that their absence in the present decision render it unreasonable.

issues.issue: Can the court fill gaps in the officer's reasons by reviewing the record (NL Nurses)?
issues.applicant_position: Reasons cannot be rescued by the record; the officer had to carry out the assessment himself.
issues.respondent_position: Court can compare the employer letter with NOC 0631 and supplement the reasons from the record.
issues.result_quote: the principles espoused in NL Nurses do not extend to rectifying a failure of the Officer to carry out his duty.
